caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, happy, energetic, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Get your fingers ready! Let's count!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, four, five,
Counting makes us feel alive!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten,
Paws and Claws, let's count again!

[Verse]
Rory has one big ball to bounce,
Bounce it, bounce it, let's all count!
One! One! Bounce, bounce, bounce,
Rory's got one ball to bounce!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, four, five,
Counting makes us feel alive!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten,
Paws and Claws, let's count again!

[Verse]
Ziggy has two pink balls of yarn,
Rolling, rolling round the barn!
One, two! Roll, roll, roll,
Ziggy's got two balls to roll!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, four, five,
Counting makes us feel alive!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten,
Paws and Claws, let's count again!

[Verse]
Waffles has three bones to hide,
Dig, dig, dig, in the garden outside!
One, two, three! Dig, dig, dig,
Waffles' bones are hidden deep!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, four, five,
Counting makes us feel alive!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten,
Paws and Claws, let's count again!

[Verse]
Pebble has four fish for tea,
Splash, splash, splashing in the sea!
One, two, three, four! Splash, splash, splash,
Pebble eats them in a flash!

[Bridge]
Hold up one finger, now hold up two,
Three, four, five, now how about you?
Wiggle all ten, wiggle them high,
Ten little fingers waving bye bye!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, four, five,
Counting makes us feel alive!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten,
Paws and Claws, let's count again!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, four, five,
Counting makes us feel alive!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten,
Paws and Claws, let's count again!

[Outro]
Great counting, friends! See you next time!
